title: Lightly Crisp Goan Rice Spring Rolls
description: A satvik-friendly Goan dish featuring rice paper sheets and mushimono-steam, perfect for a brunch mood, with a jammy and crisp texture.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, cabbage, and beans

instructions: Prepare the filling by mixing cooked rice, mixed vegetables, onion, ginger, and goan spices in a bowl.
Lay a rice paper sheet on a flat surface and brush with coconut oil.
Place about 1/4 cup of the filling in the center of the rice paper sheet.
Fold the bottom half of the rice paper sheet over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the sheet to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining rice paper sheets and filling.
Steam the spring rolls in a mushimono-steam basket for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of coconut oil over medium heat.
Pan-fry the steamed spring rolls until they are lightly crisp and golden brown.
Serve the spring rolls hot with your favorite chutney or sauce.
